name: Before-After-Bridge (BAB)
axiom: Show today, show the day it is fixed, then show the bridge between them.
trigger: Cold outreach, case studies and transformation proposals, where the reader must want the after before hearing the how.

steps.text: Before: the current state, including what it costs.
After: the same scene, with the cost gone.
Bridge: the mechanism that moves one to the other.
Proof: who has already crossed it.

antiPattern.violation: Describing the after in abstractions the reader cannot picture, so the bridge leads somewhere they do not want to go.
antiPattern.remediation: Write the after as a scene with a person in it. If the reader cannot see themselves there, the bridge is too long.

parametricParams.caption: TWO SCENES AND THE WAY ACROSS
